title: Whipped cream
subtitle: Cream whipped stiff, cold and without grain
verified_note: Not timed by the maker himself yet.

result.note: About 300 g of whipped cream, enough to make 600 g of cream or to fill 40 choux buns.

time.note: 5 minutes, provided the cream and the bowl are cold.

context: Whipped cream stiffens not because you beat air into it, but because fat globules set around the air you beat in. That only works when the cream is cold: at 4 °C the fat is hard enough to build the network that holds the air. If the cream is too warm, nothing happens for a long time and then it whips straight on to butter in one go. So: everything cold, and stop the moment the peaks stand.

room.name: double cream
room.note: At least 35% fat. Single cream or cooking cream will not stiffen.

suiker.name: sugar
suiker.note: About 8% of the weight. Less for savoury use.

kom en garde, koud.name: bowl and whisk, cold
kom en garde, koud.note: Ten minutes in the freezer is enough.

stap-1.title: Whip it cold
stap-1.text: Put the cream and the sugar in a cold bowl and whisk at medium-high speed. Stop as soon as the cream holds soft, round peaks. For filling choux buns: a little stiffer, until firm peaks, but not grainy.
stap-1.why: Cold cream keeps the fat hard, and only hard fat builds the network that holds the air. Beat too long and the fat globules clump together: then you have butter with buttermilk.
tips: Bowl and whisk in the freezer for ten minutes, cream straight from the fridge.
Add the sugar before the cream is stiff, otherwise it will not whip smooth again.
Whipping by hand gives more control than a machine; a machine overshoots.

0.a: Usually too warm, or too little fat. Cream under 35% fat will not stiffen, and a warm bowl keeps the fat soft. Put bowl and whisk in the freezer and use cream from the fridge.

1.q: My cream has gone grainy. Still salvageable?
1.a: That is the start of butter; it does not turn back. Keep whipping until you have butter and use that, or start again with cold cream.

0.oorzaak: cream too warm or too little fat
0.fix: cold bowl, cold cream, at least 35% fat

1.fix: stop at firm peaks; there is no way back except starting over
